01 · What this run established

Four useful advances, with separate limits

Pitch is not just counter width

The saved PILL source used a counter-only estimate of 3.6667 px. Complete five-run H/V spans predict 4.0714 px, close to the ordinary reader’s 4.0357 px. They predict dimension 112.76, explaining the returned 113 rather than the original intended 125.

Read-only audit of saved pixels. The old true-diagonal error 0.5563 still fails. No old expectation or outcome was rewritten.

Better outline geometry is possible

The first Copperplate article reaches intended dimension 85 and passes the true-axis ratio checks in the ordinary inverted branch. Its selected quad balance and nominal span remain only 0.3333 / 0.3535, below 0.8.

Source-point ratios, first-selected ratios, stable spans and payload recovery are different evidence. Arial g and the Hebrew final mem route also fail full-context gates.

The gate can reject a decodable control

Replacing only a conventional control’s visible square finders with concentric circles still yields the exact URL in ZXing and jsQR. The strict structure gate rejects it. OpenCV does not recover it.

A limited conventional-control false negative. It does not demonstrate prose recovery or authorize a threshold change.

Copy structure needed its own fix

Floated initials split opening words during native selection. A rejected pseudo-element attempt made the initials invisible. The corrected normal inline span preserves Once / Our / Often in native paragraph selection and visibly paints the outline.

That source still fails the QR gates. Per-paragraph browser selection does not establish clipboard, native-app or plain-text portability.

03 · A limited but important counterexample

Recovery and surrogate gates can disagree

Both controls use the pinned encoder, exact https://example.com/, version 2/M, byte mode, mask 0, no ECC boost, four-module quiet zone,12 px pitch. The circular control changes only the visible finder construction. The remaining matrix modules are identical.

The gate is demonstrably overrestrictive for this one modified conventional control. That does not make all rejected native sources recoverable. No threshold changed, no native payload phase opened, and no standards-conformance or phone claim follows from these results.

Both new controls have exact immediate-repeat receipts. Their images are overt conventional QR controls, not text, custom-font QR glyphs, or a proposed product fallback.

04 · The unresolved data field

Changing many samples is not controlling many bits

A finder-sized initial does not give the surrounding prose enough independently adjustable structure. The measurements below show coupling and poor field coverage; they do not prove that every possible prose construction is impossible.

One lexical choice Changed gray pixels Changed ordinary binary pixels Touched source cells Changed source centers Independent lexical choice
read-to-scan 2439 1524 171 86 1 binary choice
small-to-minor 478 304 31 16 1 binary choice

A source grid with pitch 33/7 and dimension 85 was used only for diagnosis. Cells and center samples were not passed to a decoder. Each substitution is one binary lexical choice, regardless of how many pixels it moves. The ordinary adaptive binarizer can change pixels outside the directly changed gray-image bounds: Small→Minor begins at gray y 64, but its binary differences begin at y 48.

5.73

Source modules per normal line step

The corrected article’s 27 px leading spans 5.73 modules. Its median body advance is 11.016 px (2.34 modules), and median body ink height is 9.756 px (2.07 modules). These dimensions leave large correlated strokes and inter-line gaps.

226 / 527

Exact fixed gate definition

The first returned location must have the intended source dimension and all 3 centers within one source unit. Each selected point requires quad balance≥0.8, nominal span fraction≥0.8, stable-wide-row fraction≥0.8, at least one scored record with all 4 complete axes and worst RMS≤0.35, and all 4 true geometric axes complete with worst RMS≤0.35. Passive instrumentation must preserve the stock return.

Source centroids, source-aligned samples, threshold replicas, scored-only passes and second returned locations cannot substitute for the actual first selection. No hidden modules, pixel repair, forced extraction, transformed acceptance input or reader tuning was used.

08 · Stop reason and safe continuation

Review the criterion and the data field before another sweep

This run did not produce the breakthrough. It narrowed two independent obstacles: selected finder shape and control of the body’s data pattern. The selectable-article correction fixes a real text-contract problem, but it does not solve either obstacle.

Further font/size/offset variants would repeat the same negative mechanism. Revising a threshold would change the authorized acceptance policy. A multiword finder remains an untested idea, without a measured contour that solves its broken runs and baseline gaps. I do not have a defensible next native construction under the fixed rules. The unspent time and render allowance are not evidence of success or impossibility.

The next useful step is a read-only challenge of the circular-control interpretation and the body-control findings, followed by Ryan’s choice of a separately bounded research scope. The prompt below does not grant another three hours or launch experiments.

Fast mode and bootstrap context

My recommendation:Fast mode is reasonable for interactive follow-up if its account/usage tradeoff is acceptable. This work contains many reasoning/code-generation turns between short local jobs, so faster model responses can shorten iteration. It will not accelerate native rendering, OpenCV/ZXing execution, disk verification or Git/network time. No speedup was benchmarked and no setting changed.

OpenAI documents /fast as switching to faster execution when available, with availability depending on host, app version and account. That does not establish a model-specific desktop multiplier or price. Official Codex workflow guidance. The bootstrap supplied enough context; no missing owner information blocked this run.
